comments.author: Guilder
comments.body:
Decorated Cuirass

Stats: +1 Gunfire, unisex, 5k total fame to equip

Production: Stockholm (Item Shop NPC)
Appears at World Clock 17th Century, Phase 2

source: seesaawiki.jp/w/z_portalegre/d/ (Northern Europe Costume section)

As for the recipe, it's R15 Casting, and requires the following ingredients:

steel x40
suede x5
fine velvet x5

source: gvdb.mydns.jp/db/module/TradeDB/action/ItemShow?id=4396

Note: I'm reposting this info, as I goofed on translating two of the recipe ingredients. Otherwise, it appears to be accurate.

comments.author: Guilder
comments.body: I believe so. I've seen two people wearing it, and I've seen a recipe in Stockholm at the Item Shop NPC that matches the above info. I don't have r15 Casting, but I do have the recipe's ingredients, so I can hopefully obtain one of these myself, soon.

comments.author: Guilder
comments.body:
In addition to blue (casting recipe) and black (item shop), a red version of this armor will one day exist as well:

rabbilog.blog46.fc2.com/blog-entry-383.html

"Van Kool Armor" (Or Vancool, Van Cool...)

Stats:

Durability 100
Formality 30
Attack 8
Defense 90

Accuracy+2
Guard+1
Ballistics+1

20k fame and title "Van Cool" required to equip. That title seems to be Battle Campaign related? It can also be upgraded to EX form; that version requires 40k fame, the title, and has an EX effect of "special bullets effect increased incidence (Rank10)".

I don't know exactly when this armor will be added, but I'm expecting it will be during Age of Revolution, chapter 1, or later. Cheers, and good voyaging.
